name: 10549 · Mount Kisco, NY
findings: ZIP 10549 (Mount Kisco) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10549 (Mount Kisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10549 (Mount Kisco) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
